messages:
maria (infosec): Heads-up: Compliance will tighten egress defaults in eu-west-1 Tue 02:00 UTC. This denies outbound to some legacy endpoints used by GPU onboarding and may block ephemeral KMS grants.

sam (platform): Which endpoints are blocked? can we get an allowlist? :thinking_face:

maria (infosec): Targets: non-approved outbound IPs. Affected: keystore.internal.redwood, bootstrap-shard-3.redwood, and an old telemetry sink. Rule id fw-eu-2026-07.

raj (infra): Repro in staging: new nodes hit `keystore: handshake timeout` then `failed to obtain ephemeral-key`. Logs: `node-23 init ERROR: keystore handshake failed: tcp timeout` -> fallback to cached grant -> degraded warmup.

kevin (oncall): Staging warm-pool dropped 85% -> 40% in ~6m when rule applied. Cache fallback increased token reuse.

jen (sre): Short-term: scoped audit-sampling exception for bootstrap path only? preserves logs but allows traffic. Long-term: route keystore through approved proxy CIDR.

maria (infosec): Compliance will allow a scoped exception if we provide: 1) exact IPs/domains, 2) timebox (<=48h), 3) audit retention bumped to 180d. Need list + justification by EOD.

sam (platform): Proposed allowlist: `keystore.internal.redwood:443`, `bootstrap-shard-*.redwood:443`, `10.200.4.0/24` (edge proxy). I'll open a PR to fw-regions: https://git.redwood/fw-regions/pulls/1245 with ACL diff.

raj (infra): We'll canary the exception AZ-by-AZ. Toggle script: `./ops/node-onboard --region eu-west-1 --az a --canary on`.

kevin (oncall): I'll monitor `gpu_warmpool_fill` and `keystore_handshake_5xx`. Rollback if warm-pool falls >20% or keystore 5xx spike.

maria (infosec): audit-bot, open ticket with firewall change, approvers, retention change.

audit-bot: Created ticket AUD-2026-331 "Scoped egress exception for GPU onboarding (eu-west-1)" assigned to maria (infosec), sam (platform).

jen (sre): PR checklist: include smoke test `curl -sSf https://keystore.internal.redwood/health` from new node and runbook snippet to revoke exception: `./infra/fwctl apply --rule-id fw-eu-2026-07 --remove-exception onboarders`.

sam (platform): PR posted with smoke test + canary steps. tagging @maria for approval.

maria (infosec): Approved for 24h exception. Retention bumped. Require post-mortem on reliance on legacy endpoints. :white_check_mark: 

raj (infra): Scheduling node backfills in 30m once PR merges. Paging hooks configured.

kevin (oncall): Oncall will watch channel and post short metric updates. Ping me if warm-pool falls or keystore errors >1% for 5m.

maria (infosec): Goal: remove exception within 24h and have proxy path ready next sprint.

sam (platform): Merging PR now. :rocket:
